<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Pythagoras Theorem Diagram</title>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Styles for animations -->
  <style>
    @keyframes pulseA {
      0% { fill: rgba(52, 152, 219, 0.2); stroke-width: 2; }
      50% { fill: rgba(52, 152, 219, 0.6); stroke-width: 4; }
      100% { fill: rgba(52, 152, 219, 0.2); stroke-width: 2; }
    }
    @keyframes pulseB {
      0% { fill: rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.2); stroke-width: 2; }
      50% { fill: rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.6); stroke-width: 4; }
      100% { fill: rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.2); stroke-width: 2; }
    }
    @keyframes pulseC {
      0% { fill: rgba(231, 76, 60, 0.2); stroke-width: 2; }
      50% { fill: rgba(231, 76, 60, 0.6); stroke-width: 4; }
      100% { fill: rgba(231, 76, 60, 0.2); stroke-width: 2; }
    }
    .sq-a { animation: pulseA 4s infinite; }
    .sq-b { animation: pulseB 4s infinite; animation-delay: 1.33s; }
    .sq-c { animation: pulseC 4s infinite; animation-delay: 2.66s; }
  </style>

  <!-- Title & Explanatory Text -->
  <text x="400" y="40" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2c3e50">Pythagoras' Theorem: a² + b² = c²</text>
  <text x="400" y="68" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#555555">In any right-angled triangle, the sum of the squares on the shorter sides equals the square on the hypotenuse.</text>

  <!-- 
    Triangle coordinates (scaled by 30px per unit):
    Origin of triangle at (300, 360)
    Side a = 3 units -> length 90px (vertical going up) -> (300, 270)
    Side b = 4 units -> length 120px (horizontal going right) -> (420, 360)
    Side c = 5 units -> hypotenuse from (300, 270) to (420, 360)
  -->

  <!-- Squares attached to sides -->
  <!-- Square on side a (3 units high, to the left): x from 210 to 300, y from 270 to 360 -->
  <rect class="sq-a" x="210" y="270" width="90" height="90" stroke="#2980b9" rx="4"/>
  
  <!-- Square on side b (4 units wide, downwards): x from 300 to 420, y from 360 to 480 -->
  <rect class="sq-b" x="300" y="360" width="120" height="120" stroke="#27ae60" rx="4"/>

  <!-- Square on hypotenuse c (5 units, outwards to the top-right). -->
  <polygon class="sq-c" points="300,270 420,360 510,240 390,150" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Grid lines inside square a (3x3 grid) -->
  <line x1="240" y1="270" x2="240" y2="360" stroke="#bdc3c7" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  <line x1="270" y1="270" x2="270" y2="360" stroke="#bdc3c7" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  <line x1="210" y1="300" x2="300" y2="300" stroke="#bdc3c7" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  <line x1="210" y1="330" x2="300" y2="330" stroke="#bdc3c7" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>

  <!-- Grid lines inside square b (4x4 grid) -->
  <line x1="330" y1="360" x2="330" y2="480" stroke="#bdc3c7" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  <line x1="360" y1="360" x2="360" y2="480" stroke="#bdc3c7" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  <line x1="390" y1="360" x2="390" y2="480" stroke="#bdc3c7" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  <line x1="300" y1="390" x2="420" y2="390" stroke="#bdc3c7" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  <line x1="300" y1="420" x2="420" y2="420" stroke="#bdc3c7" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  <line x1="300" y1="450" x2="420" y2="450" stroke="#bdc3c7" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>

  <!-- Triangle Fill (Right-angled triangle) -->
  <polygon points="300,270 300,360 420,360" fill="#fcf3cf" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Right angle marker -->
  <polyline points="300,342 318,342 318,360" fill="none" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Labels for side lengths (placed completely outside the shapes to avoid overlap) -->
  <text x="195" y="320" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2980b9" text-anchor="middle">a = 3</text>
  <text x="360" y="500" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#27ae60" text-anchor="middle">b = 4</text>
  <text x="475" y="295" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#c0392b" text-anchor="middle">hypotenuse, c = 5</text>

  <!-- Labels for Square Areas -->
  <text x="255" y="320" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2980b9" text-anchor="middle">a² = 9</text>
  <text x="360" y="425" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#27ae60" text-anchor="middle">b² = 16</text>
  <text x="445" y="255" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#c0392b" text-anchor="middle">c² = 25</text>

  <!-- Information Panel on the Right -->
  <rect x="530" y="100" width="240" height="340" rx="10" fill="#f8f9fa" stroke="#bdc3c7" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="650" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2c3e50">Calculation</text>

  <text x="550" y="180" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#2980b9">• Area a² = 3² = 9</text>
  <text x="550" y="220" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#27ae60">• Area b² = 4² = 16</text>
  <text x="550" y="260" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#c0392b">• Area c² = 5² = 25</text>

  <line x1="550" y1="290" x2="750" y2="290" stroke="#bdc3c7" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Equation box / highlight -->
  <rect x="545" y="320" width="210" height="90" rx="6" fill="#ebf5fb" stroke="#3498db" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <text x="650" y="350" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2c3e50">a² + b² = c²</text>
  <text x="650" y="385" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#27ae60">9 + 16 = 25</text>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Parts of a Circle</title>
  
  <style>
    /* Styling & Fonts */
    .bg { fill: #ffffff; }
    .title-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; }
    .body-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 15px; fill: #334155; }
    .label-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; }
    .formula-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0369a1; }
    
    /* Circle components */
    .circle-base { fill: #f8fafc; stroke: #64748b; stroke-width: 3; }
    .circumference-path { fill: none; stroke: #2563eb; stroke-width: 5; stroke-dasharray: 6 6; }
    .radius-line { stroke: #10b981; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linecap: round; }
    .diameter-line { stroke: #d97706; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linecap: round; }
    .centre-dot { fill: #ef4444; }
    
    /* Animations */
    @keyframes rotateRadius {
      0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }
    
    @keyframes pulseDot {
      0%, 100% { r: 6px; opacity: 1; }
      50% { r: 9px; opacity: 0.7; }
    }

    .animated-radius {
      transform-origin: 350px 250px;
      animation: rotateRadius 10s linear infinite;
    }
    
    .pulsing-centre {
      animation: pulseDot 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    /* Circumference tracer animation using stroke-dashoffset */
    @keyframes traceCirc {
      0% { stroke-dashoffset: 942; }
      100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
    }
    
    .tracer-circle {
      fill: none;
      stroke: #8b5cf6;
      stroke-width: 5;
      stroke-dasharray: 942;
      stroke-dashoffset: 942;
      animation: traceCirc 10s linear infinite;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect class="bg" width="800" height="500"/>

  <!-- Title & Subtitle -->
  <text x="400" y="35" text-anchor="middle" class="title-text">Parts of a Circle</text>
  <text x="400" y="58" text-anchor="middle" class="body-text">GCSE Mathematics: Visualising key circle definitions</text>

  <!-- LEFT PANEL: Info Card -->
  <rect x="30" y="85" width="230" height="385" rx="10" fill="#f1f5f9" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="145" y="115" text-anchor="middle" class="label-text">Key Definitions</text>
  
  <text x="45" y="150" class="body-text" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">Centre:</text>
  <text x="45" y="170" class="body-text">The exact middle point</text>
  <text x="45" y="190" class="body-text">of the circle.</text>

  <text x="45" y="230" class="body-text" font-weight="bold" fill="#10b981">Radius:</text>
  <text x="45" y="250" class="body-text">Distance from centre</text>
  <text x="45" y="270" class="body-text">to the edge.</text>

  <text x="45" y="310" class="body-text" font-weight="bold" fill="#d97706">Diameter:</text>
  <text x="45" y="330" class="body-text">Across the circle</text>
  <text x="45" y="350" class="body-text">through the centre.</text>

  <text x="45" y="390" class="body-text" font-weight="bold" fill="#8b5cf6">Circumference:</text>
  <text x="45" y="410" class="body-text">The perimeter</text>
  <text x="45" y="430" class="body-text">distance around.</text>


  <!-- RIGHT AREA: Circle Diagram (Centred around x=540, y=260) -->
  
  <!-- Static Base Circle Area -->
  <circle cx="540" cy="260" r="150" class="circle-base"/>

  <!-- Diameter Line (Orange) -->
  <line x1="390" y1="260" x2="690" y2="260" class="diameter-line"/>
  <text x="540" y="250" text-anchor="middle" class="label-text" fill="#d97706">diameter</text>

  <!-- Animated Radius Line (Green) sweeping around -->
  <g class="animated-radius">
    <line x1="350" y1="250" x2="500" y2="250" class="radius-line"/>
    <circle cx="425" cy="250" r="4" fill="#10b981"/>
    <text x="425" y="235" text-anchor="middle" class="label-text" fill="#10b981">radius</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Centre Point (Red) -->
  <circle cx="540" cy="260" r="6" class="centre-dot pulsing-centre"/>
  <text x="555" y="280" text-anchor="start" class="label-text" fill="#ef4444">centre</text>

  <!-- Animated Circumference Tracer (Purple line tracing the rim continuously) -->
  <circle cx="540" cy="260" r="150" class="tracer-circle"/>

  <!-- Circumference Label with pointer -->
  <path d="M 646 154 L 680 120" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <text x="690" y="115" text-anchor="start" class="label-text" fill="#8b5cf6">circumference</text>

  <!-- Formula Callout Box -->
  <rect x="420" y="430" width="240" height="40" rx="6" fill="#e0f2fe" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="540" y="455" text-anchor="middle" class="formula-text">diameter = 2 × radius</text>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Series Circuit GCSE Physics</title>
  
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #ffffff; }
    .wire { fill: none; stroke: #2c3e50; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .panel { fill: #f8f9fa; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 2; rx: 8px; }
    .title-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .body-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #334155; }
    .bold-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; }
    .label-cell { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; fill: #b91c1c; text-anchor: middle; }
    .label-lamp { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; fill: #d97706; text-anchor: middle; }
    .label-meter { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; fill: #047857; text-anchor: middle; }
    .electron { fill: #2563eb; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect class="bg" width="800" height="500"/>

  <!-- Info Panel (Left side explanations) -->
  <rect class="panel" x="30" y="30" width="350" height="440"/>
  <text x="205" y="65" class="title-text">Series Circuit Principles</text>
  
  <text x="50" y="105" class="bold-text">1. Single Loop:</text>
  <text x="50" y="128" class="body-text">There is only one path for the</text>
  <text x="50" y="148" class="body-text">charge to flow around.</text>

  <text x="50" y="193" class="bold-text">Current:</text>
  <text x="50" y="216" class="body-text">The <tspan fill="#2563eb" font-weight="bold">current</tspan> is the same</text>
  <text x="50" y="236" class="body-text">everywhere in the loop (0.2 A).</text>

  <text x="50" y="281" class="bold-text">Voltage:</text>
  <text x="50" y="304" class="body-text">The <tspan fill="#b91c1c" font-weight="bold">voltage</tspan> of the <tspan fill="#b91c1c" font-weight="bold">cell</tspan> (6 V)</text>
  <text x="50" y="324" class="body-text">is shared between components</text>
  <text x="50" y="344" class="body-text">(3 V + 3 V).</text>

  <text x="50" y="389" class="bold-text">Rule:</text>
  <text x="50" y="412" class="body-text">If one component breaks, the</text>
  <text x="50" y="432" class="body-text">whole circuit stops working.</text>

  <!-- Circuit Drawing Area (Right Side) -->
  <rect class="panel" x="410" y="30" width="360" height="440"/>
  
  <!-- Wires (Loop: Left=460, Right=720, Top=120, Bottom=380) -->
  <!-- Top wire with Cell -->
  <path class="wire" d="M 460,120 L 520,120 M 580,120 L 720,120"/>
  <!-- Right wire with Lamp 2 -->
  <path class="wire" d="M 720,120 L 720,230 M 720,270 L 720,380"/>
  <!-- Bottom wire with Ammeter -->
  <path class="wire" d="M 720,380 L 610,380 M 570,380 L 460,380"/>
  <!-- Left wire with Lamp 1 -->
  <path class="wire" d="M 460,380 L 460,270 M 460,230 L 460,120"/>

  <!-- COMPONENTS -->
  
  <!-- Cell (Top) -->
  <g transform="translate(520, 120)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-15" x2="0" y2="15" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="15" y1="-25" x2="15" y2="25" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="30" y1="-15" x2="30" y2="15" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="45" y1="-25" x2="45" y2="25" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="4"/>
    <text x="22" y="-35" class="label-cell">6 V cell</text>
    <text x="-8" y="5" class="body-text" font-weight="bold">+</text>
    <text x="53" y="5" class="body-text" font-weight="bold">-</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Lamp 1 (Left) -->
  <g transform="translate(460, 250)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="20" fill="#fff" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="-14" y1="-14" x2="14" y2="14" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="-14" y1="14" x2="14" y2="-14" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Labels safely positioned to the left to avoid wire/overlap -->
    <text x="-32" y="-5" class="label-lamp" text-anchor="end">Lamp 1</text>
    <text x="-32" y="15" class="body-text" fill="#b91c1c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">3 V</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Lamp 2 (Right) -->
  <g transform="translate(720, 250)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="20" fill="#fff" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="-14" y1="-14" x2="14" y2="14" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="-14" y1="14" x2="14" y2="-14" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Labels safely positioned to the right -->
    <text x="32" y="-5" class="label-lamp" text-anchor="start">Lamp 2</text>
    <text x="32" y="15" class="body-text" fill="#b91c1c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">3 V</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Ammeter (Bottom) -->
  <g transform="translate(590, 380)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="20" fill="#fff" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="0" y="5" class="label-meter" text-anchor="middle">A</text>
    <text x="0" y="36" class="label-meter" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">0.2 A</text>
    <text x="0" y="-28" class="body-text" font-size="13" fill="#047857" text-anchor="middle">current</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Second Ammeter to show current is the same everywhere -->
  <g transform="translate(590, 120)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="16" fill="#fff" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="0" y="4" class="label-meter" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle">A</text>
    <text x="0" y="-22" class="body-text" font-size="12" fill="#047857" text-anchor="middle">0.2 A</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ANIMATED ELECTRONS (Current flow) -->
  <!-- Circuit loop path: Top-left(460,120) -> Top-right(720,120) -> Bottom-right(720,380) -> Bottom-left(460,380) Z -->
  <path id="circuitPath" d="M 460,120 L 720,120 L 720,380 L 460,380 Z" fill="none" stroke="none"/>

  <!-- Electrons moving continuously around loop -->
  <circle class="electron" r="5">
    <animateMotion dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite">
      <mpath href="#circuitPath"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>
  <circle class="electron" r="5">
    <animateMotion dur="4s" begin="-1s" repeatCount="indefinite">
      <mpath href="#circuitPath"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>
  <circle class="electron" r="5">
    <animateMotion dur="4s" begin="-2s" repeatCount="indefinite">
      <mpath href="#circuitPath"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>
  <circle class="electron" r="5">
    <animateMotion dur="4s" begin="-3s" repeatCount="indefinite">
      <mpath href="#circuitPath"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Photosynthesis</title>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <style>
    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(0.95); }

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>States of Matter - Solid, Liquid and Gas Particle Arrangement and Motion</title>
  
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #ffffff; }
    .box { fill: #f8fafc; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 2.5; rx: 12; }
    .title { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .caption { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #475569; text-anchor: middle; }
    .particle-solid { fill: #3b82f6; stroke: #1e3a8a; stroke-width: 1.5; }
    .particle-liquid { fill: #10b981; stroke: #065f46; stroke-width: 1.5; }
    .particle-gas { fill: #f59e0b; stroke: #92400e; stroke-width: 1.5; }
    .heading { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; text-anchor: middle; }
    
    /* Solid vibration */
    @keyframes vibrate {
      0% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
      25% { transform: translate(-2px, 1px); }
      50% { transform: translate(1px, -2px); }
      75% { transform: translate(2px, 2px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
    }
    .vib-1 { animation: vibrate 0.4s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .vib-2 { animation: vibrate 0.35s infinite ease-in-out; animation-delay: 0.1s; }
    .vib-3 { animation: vibrate 0.45s infinite ease-in-out; animation-delay: 0.2s; }

    /* Liquid gentle flow */
    @keyframes flow1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(5px, -4px); }
      66% { transform: translate(-4px, 3px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes flow2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(-6px, 4px); }
      66% { transform: translate(3px, -5px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    .liq-1 { animation: flow1 3s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .liq-2 { animation: flow2 3.5s infinite ease-in-out; }

    /* Gas fast movement */
    @keyframes gas-move-1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(55px, -45px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-35px, -70px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-60px, 30px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes gas-move-2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-65px, 50px); }
      50% { transform: translate(45px, 60px); }
      75% { transform: translate(50px, -40px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes gas-move-3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(40px, 60px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-50px, -30px); }
      75% { transform: translate(30px, -50px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    .gas-1 { animation: gas-move-1 2s infinite linear; }
    .gas-2 { animation: gas-move-2 1.7s infinite linear; }
    .gas-3 { animation: gas-move-3 2.2s infinite linear; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect class="bg" width="800" height="500"/>

  <!-- Main Title -->
  <text x="400" y="38" class="heading">States of Matter & Particle Arrangement</text>

  <!-- ==================== SOLID ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(30, 60)">
    <rect class="box" x="0" y="0" width="225" height="300"/>
    <text x="112" y="35" class="title">solid</text>
    
    <!-- Solid Particles (Regular grid, fixed positions with vibration class) -->
    <g transform="translate(42, 65)">
      <!-- Row 1 -->
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="0" cy="0" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="30" cy="0" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="60" cy="0" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="90" cy="0" r="11"/>
      
      <!-- Row 2 -->
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="0" cy="30" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="30" cy="30" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="60" cy="30" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="90" cy="30" r="11"/>

      <!-- Row 3 -->
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="0" cy="60" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="30" cy="60" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="60" cy="60" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="90" cy="60" r="11"/>

      <!-- Row 4 -->
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="0" cy="90" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="30" cy="90" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="60" cy="90" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="90" cy="90" r="11"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Captions -->
    <text x="112" y="240" class="caption">Close together</text>
    <text x="112" y="262" class="caption">Vibrate in fixed positions</text>
    <text x="112" y="284" class="caption">Regular arrangement</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== LIQUID ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(287, 60)">
    <rect class="box" x="0" y="0" width="225" height="300"/>
    <text x="112" y="35" class="title">liquid</text>
    
    <!-- Liquid Particles (Close, irregular, sliding past) -->
    <g transform="translate(38, 60)">
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="15" cy="15" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="45" cy="12" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="75" cy="18" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="105" cy="14" r="11"/>

      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="25" cy="45" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="58" cy="42" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="88" cy="48" r="11"/>
      
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="12" cy="78" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="42" cy="72" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="75" cy="75" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="102" cy="78" r="11"/>

      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="28" cy="108" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="60" cy="105" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="90" cy="110" r="11"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Captions -->
    <text x="112" y="240" class="caption">Close together</text>
    <text x="112" y="262" class="caption">Move past each other</text>
    <text x="112" y="284" class="caption">Random arrangement</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== GAS ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(544, 60)">
    <rect class="box" x="0" y="0" width="225" height="300"/>
    <text x="112" y="35" class="title">gas</text>
    
    <!-- Gas Particles (Far apart, fast straight-line movement) -->
    <g transform="translate(112, 130)">
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-1" cx="0" cy="0" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-2" cx="-50" cy="-40" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-3" cx="55" cy="-35" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-1" cx="-40" cy="45" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-2" cx="45" cy="40" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-3" cx="0" cy="-70" r="11"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Motion trails / arrows for gas -->
    <g stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3,3" fill="none">
      <path d="M 60 90 Q 80 70 100 80"/>
      <path d="M 170 80 Q 150 110 130 95"/>
      <path d="M 80 180 Q 100 160 120 175"/>
      <path d="M 160 200 Q 140 180 150 160"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Captions -->
    <text x="112" y="240" class="caption">Far apart</text>
    <text x="112" y="262" class="caption">Move fast in all directions</text>
    <text x="112" y="284" class="caption">Random arrangement</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Footer summary box -->
  <rect x="30" y="380" width="740" height="90" rx="8" fill="#f1f5f9" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="400" y="410" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="bold" fill="#334155" text-anchor="middle">Summary of Particle Model</text>
  <text x="400" y="437" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14px" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">Particles in all states have energy and move, but the space and freedom of movement</text>
  <text x="400" y="457" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14px" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">change from solid to liquid to gas.</text>

</svg>
